description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deep Forest Hermit, adding {G}.
Deep Forest Hermit dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Deep Forest Hermit on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Deep Forest Hermit from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrel tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.
